translations.web: who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.
translations.bsb: On receiving this order, he placed them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
translations.kjv: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
translations.asv: who, having received such a charge, cast them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
